ConfigFields.Description: Enable daily auto check-in at 09:00 and 21:00 local time for CN accounts (default true).
ConfigFields.Name: checkin_auto

ConfigFields.Description: Auto disable CN / delete Global when credits exhausted; re-enable CN after check-in restores credits (default true).
ConfigFields.Name: lifecycle_auto

ConfigFields.Description: Enable daily access-token refresh at 22:00 local time to prevent Keycloak offline-session expiry (default true).
ConfigFields.Name: token_keepalive

ConfigFields.Description: Insert U+200B into configured blocked terms in system/developer prompt text and tool title/description fields (default false).
ConfigFields.Name: desensitize

ConfigFields.Description: Editable literal term list for desensitize; missing uses the built-in 85 terms and [] means an empty custom list.
ConfigFields.Name: desensitize_terms

ConfigFields.Description: Optional model IDs, single-line strings only. A non-empty list is the complete catalog and bypasses WorkBuddy catalog HTTP and cache; models.dev metadata fetch and cache still apply. Missing, null, or [] keeps dynamic WorkBuddy discovery.
ConfigFields.Name: models

ConfigFields.Description: OAuth request profile: cli (default) or explicit WorkBuddy desktop profile.
ConfigFields.Name: oauth_client_mode

ConfigFields.Description: Probe strict CN enterprise credits before personal resource packages (default false; Global unchanged).
ConfigFields.Name: enterprise_credits

ConfigFields.Description: Optional Bearer key enforced by WorkBuddy for mutating management endpoints; also env WB_MANAGEMENT_KEY.
ConfigFields.Name: management_key

ConfigFields.Description: Optional plugin-level proxy for all WorkBuddy HTTP traffic. Supports http, https, socks5, and socks5h; empty preserves existing routing and host-bridged calls inherit CPA. Invalid settings fail closed. Explicit proxy traffic bypasses CPA request-log.
ConfigFields.Name: proxy-url

ConfigFields.Description: Multi-account selection: off (defer to built-in, default) or credits (pick the panel-selected account, with non-exhausted fallback). WARNING: when off + lifecycle_auto=false, exhausted accounts may still be routed — enable lifecycle_auto or set scheduler_mode=credits.
ConfigFields.Name: scheduler_mode

ConfigFields.Description: Optional override of CPAMP usage import URL (default http://cpa-manager-plus:18317/v0/management/usage/import; also env USAGE_REPORT_URL).
ConfigFields.Name: usage_report_url

ConfigFields.Description: Optional CPAMP admin key override. Prefer auto-detect from env CPAMP_ADMIN_KEY / USAGE_REPORT_KEY or secret file /run/secrets/cpamp_admin_key.
ConfigFields.Name: usage_report_key
